name: Kitchen20
description: This paper introduces a new raw-audio, environmental, kitchen-related, non-vocal dataset to fill what we consider as a gap in the context of audio datasets. Our so-called Kitchen20 dataset is compared to other datasets such as ESC-50 and shown that both datasets can be merged together in what we call ESC-70. A human quantitave appreciation of the audio samples contained in Kitchen20 is provided as well as several machine learning benchmarks on both Kitchen20 and ESC-70.
reputation: A niche dataset used in audio-based human action recognition research; moderately cited within the audio-activity community but not a mainstream benchmark.
notes: Audio-only action recognition benchmark with limited scale; potential class imbalance and environmental noise variability. Not an LLM benchmark; results are modality-specific and may not transfer to multimodal settings.
